steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Automation uses control systems to operate equipment with minimal human intervention, improving consistency and reducing cost.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Industrial robots perform repetitive, precise or hazardous tasks: welding, painting, assembly and material handling.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: CAD/CAM integration links design directly to manufacture: a CAD model generates CNC code automatically, reducing errors and lead time.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Industry 4.0 connects machines, sensors and systems through IoT for data-driven manufacturing.

steps.title: Exam tips
steps.body: In technology questions, always consider both benefits AND drawbacks for balanced evaluation. Name specific technologies (Industry 4.0, IoT, cobots) rather than general statements. Link new technology to a specific engineering outcome: faster, cheaper, more precise or more flexible. The social impact of automation (job displacement vs new skilled roles) is a common extended-response topic. CAD/CAM integration is a reliable answer for how technology has changed manufacturing.
